news.title: MWL Extends Condolences over School Roof Collapse in Pakistan's Peshawar
news.og_title: MWL Extends Condolences over School Roof Collapse in Pakistan's Peshawar
news.og_desc:
Makkah, October 16, 2026, SPA -- The Muslim World League (MWL) extended its sincere condolences and sympathy to the government and people of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and the families of the victims following the collapse of a school roof in the Pakistani city of Peshawar.
    In a statement, MWL Secretary-General and Chairman of the Organization of Muslim Scholars Sheikh Dr. Mohammed Al-Issa expressed the MWL's solidarity and sympathy with Pakistan, its people, and the families of the deceased in this tragic incident.
    -- SPA

news.og_desc: The Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed the Kingdom’s sincere condolences and sympathy to the Islamic Republic of Pakistan following the collapse of part of a school building in Peshawar, which resulted in the deaths and injuries of several students, the Saudi Press Agency reported Friday.
